verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents interact with the Stripe API (including invoicing endpoints), so natural-language operation is possible through an external AI client. There is no evidence of a native natural-language interface in the Invoicing Dashboard itself, so this story needs extra tools. Missing for 10: a built-in natural-language command interface in the product, invoicing-specific natural-language workflow documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.
